title: Hello world
excerpt: The first post. Posts live in content/blog.json — edit the file, or use the admin panel at /admin.
content:
Post bodies are HTML. Write them by hand in content/blog.json, or sign in at /admin and use the form.

The id is the URL slug: this post is at /blog/hello-world.

title: A second post, so the tag filter has something to do
excerpt: Tags are a flat list of strings. The blog page builds its filter bar from whatever tags exist.
content: Delete both of these and write your own.
